aspect: EXAMPLE - property not returned on removal
description: A University of Arizona survey of Mexicans deported from the US found 39% said American authorities did not return their belongings - leaving people without IDs, wallets or phones, unable to call anyone, access money, or prove identity to Mexican authorities on arrival.
energy_note: Handed back across the line with nothing in his pockets.

aspect: Arriving undocumented in your own country
description: Without ID he cannot claim the reception centre benefit, board a bus home, rent a room or start work - in the country of his own nationality.
energy_note: A Mexican with no way to prove he is Mexican.

aspect: Replacement requires the thing being replaced
description: Getting a new acta or CURP typically requires identification, which is the thing that is gone. The loop is resolved by someone's discretion, or not at all.
